prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one standalone decorative transparent PNG for a mechanical-engineering portfolio Experience section.
Primary request: a real-looking steel mechanic's toolbox with its lid open, unmistakably a workshop toolbox.
Subject: a compact traditional rectangular sheet-steel toolbox with a deep rigid lower tub, a single hinged lid held open around 105 degrees, rolled metal rim, visible hinge, practical steel carry handle on the lid, and one small front latch. Inside is a small orderly set of three steel spanners, one realistic vernier caliper and two screwdrivers arranged in a fitted shallow tool tray; all tools are recognizable and mechanically plausible.
Style/medium: high-fidelity photorealistic studio product render, precise metal geometry, natural scale and restrained tactile detail.
Composition/framing: square 1024 by 1024 canvas, three-quarter perspective slightly from above so the open lid and organized tools are visible, entire object intact and centered, generous transparent margin on all four sides.
Lighting/mood: soft warm natural studio light, clean believable reflections and self-shadowing.
Color palette: restrained indigo enamel body (#334E68), brushed silver steel hardware and tools, a tiny subtly worn vermilion front latch (#C45A3D).
Materials/textures: enamel over formed steel with understated wear at a few edges, brushed steel, crisp realistic joinery.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background; isolated object cutout only.
Constraints: produce exactly one image; no lettering, numbers, slogans, logos, labels, watermarks or UI; no background, floor, pedestal, colored backdrop, checkerboard pattern or canvas shadow. It must read clearly as an open steel mechanic's toolbox, never a suitcase, toy, briefcase or file folder. No extra props, no human, no cropped or detached parts. Preserve real transparency.
scope: Generic decorative object. Not a photograph of the user’s equipment or project evidence.
